This page tracks **released versions** of the dataset, documentation, and toolchain (dataset
bundles, per-class GeoJSON, RDF deltas, and the docs site). For the 17-snapshot PSGC timeline and
how each snapshot becomes an RDF delta, see [PSGC snapshot history](rdf/snapshots.qmd).

Releases are tagged with CalVer of the form **`vYYYY.M.DD.PATCH`** (e.g. `v2026.4.13.0`). See
[Releases & versioning](boundaries/download.qmd) for the tag convention and the release workflow.

## v2026.4.13.0 — 2026-06-16

Inaugural data release, shipping the fully enriched `2023-10-24` snapshot.

- **Data:** hierarchical per-class GeoJSON bundle (`barangay-boundaries-2023-10-24-hierarchical.zip`)
  plus individual per-class files (`barangays`, `provinces`, `municipalities`,
  `highly_urbanized_cities`, `independent_component_cities`, `component_cities`, `regions`,
  `country`, `special_geographic_areas`, `submunicipalities`, `non_administrative`,
  `unresolved`), `classification_report.json`, `summary.md`, and `manifest.json` checksums.

- **RDF:** PSGC change-history delta for snapshot `2023-10-24`
  (`delta.{ttl,nt,jsonld}`, W3C ORG).

- **Docs:** Quarto documentation site launched (Boundaries, Change history, Toolchain, References).

See the release on GitHub:
[`v2026.4.13.0`](https://github.com/bendlikeabamboo/barangay-boundaries-repository/releases/tag/v2026.4.13.0).
